_description: Places where one muṣḥaf prints as a single word what another prints as two, because an assimilated nūn is not written. Nothing is added or dropped: the joined word covers both numbers of the shared numbering (docs/MUSHAF-FORMAT.md, Numbering). The list is declared rather than inferred because the missing nūn changes the rasm, so no rule can tell this apart from a different reading — 40:26 أَوۡ أَن / وَأَنْ is a different word, not a join, and is deliberately not here.
